brief.purpose: A hand-mined rare frontier ore and a wearable audible survey instrument.
brief.setting: Practical late-nineteenth-century cast steel and brass, natural muted mineral colors.
brief.silhouettes: Rectangular dial plus probe; angular mineral fragment; opaque stone ore face.
brief.invariants: No neon glow, radiation warning mark, invented processing machinery or fuel capability.

reviews.finding: Legible dial/probe and mineral facets at 32px, clean alpha and subdued colors.
Faithful inventory and item lineup pass without shaders; Photon check stalled before world render.
